decisions.reason: The charting bundle extends the established map.apps platform and saw rapid releases with a dedicated page, so it meets aspirations at low cost and gives no trigger for problemistic search.
The hierarchical search bundle is a small, low-cost plugin close to the core offer; it gets only minor visibility, but with industry growth providing slack, keeping it costs little.

VueTOC was promoted on the home page as a usability improvement and builds on the existing offer, though as a component it could later be absorbed into other products, so keeping it is reasonable but uncertain.
The software platform is the flagship product line defining the firm's strategic direction, so management will commit to it regardless of short-term results.
Mobile field data capture is close to core customer needs and has its own page, and with no evidence of shortfall against aspirations it should be kept.
The search extension complements the web map apps, has a dedicated page, and needs little extra resource, so slack supports keeping it.
